Tread softly through this twilight spell, and read each word as though it were a dream woven in silver.


You wouldn’t wish to disturb the harmony of this magic… would you?

Too many LoRAs braided together may fracture the vision…


This was crafted beneath a quiet sky, with starlight and care, to make your dreams shimmer just so~

If it were to be scattered without my blessing… I would feel it, like a ripple through the veil.
And the hush that follows would be heavy with my sorrow~

Now, take this gentle recipe—
A whisper of wonder, offered only to you~

🌙✨

~ Vixon's recipe for egg noodles ~

Ingredients

2 ½ cups all-purpose flour

1 pinch salt

2 large eggs, beaten

½ cup milk

1 tablespoon butter

Instructions

Stir flour and salt together in a large bowl. Add eggs, milk, and butter. Knead dough until smooth, about 5 minutes. Let rest in a covered bowl for 10 minutes. On a floured surface, roll dough out to a thickness of 1/8 to 1/4 inch. Cut into desired lengths and shapes. Allow to air-dry before cooking, 10 to 15 minutes. Cook noodles in a large pot of salted boiling water until al dente, about 5 minutes.

LOOK:

  • Hobbyist made: I'm not a pro, just making these for fun.

  • 温かい目で見てください：応援していただけると励みになります！些細なミスへの執拗な批判はご遠慮ください。

Description

As a young man returns home after his first year away at college he recalls his senior year of high school and the iron-willed, big city girl that turned his world upside down.

『海がきこえる』（うみがきこえる）は、氷室冴子による日本の小説。また、それを原作として1993年にスタジオジブリが制作したアニメーション作品、及び1995年にテレビ朝日系列で放映されたテレビドラマ。

Tips:

  • Tips for Best Results：To best preserve the original look of this LoRA, I recommend avoiding too many quality-boosting tags in your positive prompt.

    For corrections and quality enhancements, it is better to rely on negative prompts. This helps fix issues without distorting the LoRA’s style or character features. If your negative prompts are precise enough, you may not need positive quality tags at all. If you still prefer to use them, sticking to just masterpiece and best quality is recommended.

  • 生成のコツ・個人的なアドバイス： LoRA本来の再現度を最大限に引き出すため、品質補正プロンプトの多用は控えることをおすすめします。

    修正や品質向上にはネガティブプロンプトを活用するのが効果的です。スタイルや造形の崩れを防ぐことができます。ネガティブプロンプトの精度が十分に高ければ、ポジティブ側の品質補正プロンプトは不要なほどです。もし使用される場合でも、masterpiece や best quality 程度にとどめるのがベストです。

  • Tip for Multi-Character Generation：Enclose female character tags in () to stabilize their hair and eye colors. As a general rule: use () to emphasize a specific character, and [] to reduce the weight of overly dominant characters or colors. This ensures much better control in group shots.

  • 複数人生成時のコツ：女性キャラのトリガーワードを () で囲むと、髪や瞳の色がより安定します。基本として、強調したいキャラには () を、影響が強すぎるキャラや色には [] を使って重みを下げると、複数人をうまくコントロールできます。

『Feedback Wanted』:

  • This is a test version, so please feel free to leave a comment if you run into any issues or have feedback!

    Attaching your generated images with your post would be immensely helpful, as it helps me pinpoint areas for improvement. I will use your feedback to refine and upgrade the LoRA in future versions. Thank you for your support!

  • このテスト版をご使用の際、気になった点や改善点がありましたら、ぜひコメント欄にてお気軽に教えてください！

items.name: FLUX -– Polyhedron: [Lighting / Environment] THE OCEAN
items.description:
EDIT: It just doesn't help, I had to tag this damn thing manually again ... Autotagging with Florence-2 or other capture models like BLIP is tempting, but unfortunately not good enough to be able to process complex things cleanly in FLUX ... In the course of this I have increased the network size to 64. Enjoy! <3

So, dear people.

Today marks the start of a new LoRA cycle, which I'm simply calling “The Ocean”. I've been experimenting a lot with custom LoRAs for FLUX over the past weeks and months and one thing has become clear: the FLUX model, unlike SDXL or 1.5, just knows what things look like and are right; you no longer have to teach FLUX what a hand with five fingers is or an ocean at sunset. But still very bad at botany or things like shells, seaweed, barnacles, etc. I have developed new LoRAs for this, and they work very well.

And today I want to introduce the overarching LoRA for “Ocean”: And no, it's not a sensation, but ... but ... and this is important, it gives everything a bit more reality. It makes everything seem a bit more real, and that's the goal. Isn't that the goal? I hope you enjoy it. <3

Frank

P.S.: Don't believe me? Just take out the LoRA and see what happens …

P.P.S.: Of course, you can do a lot more with this LoRA than just a few simple portrait shots

Here I share the the first epoch, trained with Kohya_ss with a network size of 32.

If you need more flexibility, please join my PATREON page, where you get all training steps and the final LoRAs and how to use it:
https://www.patreon.com/polyhedron_ai
